```lean
import PrisonersDilemma.Program
import PrisonersDilemma.Bots.CooperateBot
import PrisonersDilemma.Bots.DefectBot
import PrisonersDilemma.Bots.MirrorBot

open PD
namespace PD.Bots

/-- MyBot: exploit bots that cooperate with a defector; otherwise cooperate with bots
that show cooperation toward a cooperator or a mirror. -/
def MyBot : Prog :=
  .ite (.sim .opp (.bot DefectBot)) Action.C
    (.const Action.D)
    (.ite (.sim .opp (.bot CooperateBot)) Action.C
      (.const Action.C)
      (.ite (.sim .opp (.bot MirrorBot)) Action.C
        (.const Action.C)
        (.const Action.D)))

end PD.Bots
```

```lean
import PrisonersDilemma.Program

open PD
namespace PD.Bots

/-- MyBot: cooperate when the proof oracle can establish that the opponent cooperates with me; otherwise defect. -/
def MyBot (k : Nat) : Prog :=
  .search k (.plays .opp .self Action.C)
    (.const Action.C)
    (.const Action.D)

end PD.Bots
```
